work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: Title Page

items.text: Be a crown to him: be virtuous, and do not bring shame upon him.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift, Title Page
items.quote: A vertuous Woman is a Crowne to her Husband: But she that shameth him is as rottennesse in his Bones.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Be to your husband a true helper and comfort, not a wife in name only.
items.quote: She beareth the Name; but doth not the Worke of a Wife... a Woman giuen to Man to be an Helpe and a Comfort to him.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Be subject and obedient to your husband, as to your head.
items.citation: Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: subject and obedient to her Husband, as her Head

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Be truly a wife, not only in name but in deed: do the office and duty of a wife, being as a part of your husband and helpful to him, not a burden or blemish to him or his house.
items.citation: A Wife Indeed, A Wife in Deed.
items.quote: Euerie Wife should bee then as a part of her Husband; as a limme of him that hath her.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: TO THE RIGHT WORSHIPFVL, AND his louing Kinsman, Sir ROBERT HARLIE Knight of the BATH; And to the right worthie and religious, the Ladie BRILLIANA his Wife.

items.text: Esteem her as a precious jewel from God and be thankful to him for her.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift, Epistle Dedicatory
items.quote: what a pretious Iewell God hath in her bestowed on you, and how great a measure of thankfulnesse you owe to him

items.text: Manage your marriage as a blessed estate called by God, according to his will through his grace.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift, Epistle Dedicatory
items.quote: what a blessed estate and condition of life it is, that GOD hath pleased to call you vnto, where the same is managed through his grace according to his will

items.text: Continue in happy cohabitation for God's greater glory, your mutual comfort, and the benefit of your dependants.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift, Epistle Dedicatory
items.quote: your happy cohabitation to be long continued to his greater glory, your mutuall comfort, and the further benefit of those that may haue dependance vpon you

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.

items.text: Do not force your child's affections in marriage, for love cannot be constrained and enforcement turns it into hatred.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: Love cannot bee constrained. The verie offer of enforcement turneth it oft into hatred.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: TO THE WORSHIPFVLL MY LOVING COSENS, Mr. IOHN SCVDAMORE of Kenchurch in Hereford-shire, and Mrs ELIZABETH SCVDAMORE his Wife, many happy daies together, with all true Blessednes, both temporall and eternall.

items.text: Follow the godly example of your parents and do not degenerate from their faith and piety.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift, Dedication
items.quote: then are we truly the Children of our religious Parents and Ancestors, when in goodnes and godlines we take after those that we come of.

items.text: Live together in a Christian and religious manner, and be thankful to God for each other as his gift.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift, Dedication
items.quote: what a blessing of God you enjoy either in other, and what cause you haue to be thankefull to him either for other.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.

items.text: Be wise and not foolish, lest you be a sorrow to your father.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: a foolish sonne is his Fathers sorrow

items.text: Be peaceable and not brawling, lest you be a continual dropping to your husband.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: a brawling wife is as a continuall dropping

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Do the office and duty of a wife; be not a wife in name only, but do the work of a wife.
items.quote: beareth the Name of a Wife, and sitteth in the house as the Image of a Wife, but doth no part of the office or duty of such an one.

items.text: Be a helper to your husband, especially in the best things; do not hinder him.
items.quote: when she should be an Helper, prooueth an Hinderer; in the best things especially

items.text: Be a comfort to your husband; do not be a cross, a curse, or a discomfort.
items.quote: when she should be a comsort, proueth a crosse, a curse, a discomfort

items.text: Seek your husband's good, for you were made and ordained for his special good; do not be the means of his greatest evil.
items.quote: made and ordained for Mans special good... proueth the meanes of his greatest euill

items.text: Be one flesh with your husband, as a limb fastened to him; cleave to him.
items.quote: by Nuptiall coniunction becomming one flesh with him, she might be as a limbe restored now and fastned againe to him.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.

items.text: Advise and provide for your children in marriage, and do not match them with the ungodly.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: Parents had no hand, right or power in disposing of their children, or in aduising them and prouiding in that kinde for them.

items.text: Seek your parents' consent and advice in marriage, and do not follow your own fancy or lust.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: take aduice of their Parents, and not follow their owne fancies, and make their wanton eye, or their wandring lust, their choser and counsailer in such cases

items.text: Do not separate from your spouse, for God has joined you together.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: Those that God hath ioyned together, let not man seuer.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.

items.text: Consult your parents and accept their disposal in marriage.
items.quote: they then seeke in the Lord, when they aduise with, and are content to be disposed of by those, whom God hath giuen power ouer them

items.text: In choosing a wife, aim at virtue, wisdom, and godliness above beauty or wealth.
items.quote: learne hence what principally to aime at in the choise of a wise: to wit, at vertue and wisdome, discretion and godlinesse

items.text: Train your children in wisdom, godliness, and household skills so they may be helpers to their spouses.
items.quote: labour to traine them vp in true wisdome and discretion, in the feare of God, and such graces

items.text: Provide for your children and lay up for them.
items.quote: Parents ought to lay vp for their Children.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.

items.text: Submit and subject yourself to him, and do not refuse to be ruled by him, as to one to whom God has given you.
items.quote: submit and subiect herselfe vnto him, vnto whom God hath giuen her

items.text: Do not forsake him; live with him, for those whom God has joined are not to be separated.
items.quote: Neither is she to forsake him... they are not to bee sundred, nor seuered, whom God hath conioyned

items.text: Build up your house and be a crown and grace to your husband.
items.quote: with the wise woman, build vp the house; and be a crowne, and a grace to him that hath her

items.text: Love her, be kind to her, live in concord with her, counsel her, and give her contentment.
items.quote: as of loue, of kindnesse, of concord, counsell, contentment, &c.

items.text: Esteem her as God's special favor to you, and live with her kindly, not abusing His gift.
items.quote: liue with her, as with one giuen him and bestowed vpon him by God

items.text: Esteem each other as joined by God's counsel, receive each other as His gift, be thankful to Him, and seek each other's good.
items.quote: so esteeme either of other, as joyned by Gods counsell, as giuen by Gods hand... seeke the good either of other in God

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.

items.text: Leave your father and mother and cleave fast to your wife, and the two shall be one flesh.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.
items.quote: Therefore, saith the Holy Ghost, shall a man leaue father and mother, and be glewed vnto, or cleaue fast to his wife: and They two shall be one flesh.

items.text: Bide by your marriage; remain one flesh and do not sever until death.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.
items.quote: But man and wife must bide by it.

items.text: Do not be foolish; bring joy, not sorrow and heaviness, to your father and mother.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.
items.quote: A foolish sonne is a sorrow to his father, and an heauinesse to his mother.

items.text: Do not be contentious or disloyal; be a good wife, not a continual dropping.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.
items.quote: an euill wife is as the raine dropping in thorow the tiles

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Live together peaceably, not as dog and cat, but as man and wife.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: they liue together, as Dog and Cat; not as Man and Wife

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Provide for your own household; do not be careless in your charge.
items.quote: carelesse housholders, (and you know what the Apostle saith of such;)

items.text: Be kind and courteous to your wife; do not be harsh or currish toward her.
items.quote: a wilde beast rather than an Husband, that is not kinde and courteous, that is harsh and currish to his wife.

items.text: Do the work of a wife: be a good wife to your husband.
items.quote: as she is no wife, if she do not the worke of a wife.

items.text: Serve your master diligently and dutifully; do not be negligent or undutiful.
items.quote: negligent and vndutifull seruants

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Keep the marriage bed undefiled; have nothing to do with whoremongering or adultery, for God will judge those who do such things.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: Whore-mongers and Adulterers; God indeed will judge, and be auenged on such.

items.text: Do not be ashamed of the marriage bed or treat it as unclean; it is honorable and undefiled, and those who use it lawfully are not defiled.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: Mariage Bed is of it selfe free from filth. It is so; and they are so, that rise from it

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Comfort him in grief and heaviness, as David's harp cheered Saul.
items.quote: to cheere vp a man in griefe and heauinesse

items.text: Attend and accompany him in sickness and weakness.
items.quote: to accompanie him, and attend him in sicknesse and weaknesse

items.text: Draw in the same yoke with him in his labors and bear part of the burden in his crosses and troubles.
items.quote: to draw in the same yoke with him, in his labours and trauels, so to beare part of the burden with him in his crosses and troubles

items.text: Bear one another's burdens, as Christian husband and wife should do even more than other Christians.
items.quote: all true Christians in generall doe mutually with their Christian bre••ren, Christian Man and Wife much more.

items.text: Be his helper and companion.
items.quote: need of helpe and societie, and of the helpe and societie of such a one

items.text: Bear him children, for children are an inheritance of the Lord and the fruit of the womb.
items.quote: Children, saith the Psalmist, and the fruit of the wombe, are an Inheritance of the Lord.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Be her guide and governor, as God has appointed you.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: him that should be her Guide

items.text: Do not rule or over-rule him; let him be your guide.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: that will guide and gouerne him that should be her Guide

items.text: Be a good housewife in the house; do not be a drone living on your husband's labor.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: not a good Houswife onely in the House

items.text: Be a good wife to your husband; do him good all your days.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: that doth him good all his daies

items.text: Do not put away your wife, for God has joined you together.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: Those that God hath ioyned together, Man may not seuer.

items.text: Do the duty of a husband to her even if she is not a good wife, for God's sake.
items.citation: A Good Wife Gods Gift, A Wife in Deed
items.quote: So must thou doe the dutie of an Husband as well to a bad as to a good Wife, for conscience of Gods command.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Be his help in all things, as a second self, working with him as with four hands.
items.quote: I will make him such an Helpe, as shall be meet for him: one that shall be as his match, as his mate.

items.text: Be ever at hand to attend him, as the hand is ready to help the head.
items.quote: an Helpe euer at hand; as readie at all times to attend thee, as the Hand is to helpe the Head

items.text: Comfort and cheer him in grief and distress, bearing part of his burden and weeping with him.
items.quote: beare part of his burden with him, or comfort and cheere him vp in the bearing of it, yea, or that may but bemoane him, and weepe together with him

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Perform the work of a wife: be a true helper to your husband, not merely in name but in deed, so that your praise and reward are from God.
items.quote: she is not a Wife, that is, a Wife is Name; but she is a Wife, that is, a Wife in Deed

items.text: Do your husband good and not evil all the days of your life.
items.quote: Shee will doe him good, and no euill, so long as euer they shall liue together.

items.text: Be subject to your husband as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord.
items.quote: Such as they be Daughters of faithfull Sara; so they shall haue their part and portion with her.

items.text: Serve your master faithfully and conscientiously, as unto the Lord, and from him you will receive a royal reward.
items.quote: There is no Christian Seruant, that serueth his master faithfully and conscionably, but he shall for the same from God receiue a royall reward.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A GOOD WIFE GODS GIFT.

items.text: Remain bound to him as long as he lives; give yourself to no other.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: The wife is bound, saith the Apostle, while her husband liveth

items.text: Do not blame her for your own sin or for the troubles of marriage; acknowledge your own corruption.
items.citation: Gataker, A Good Wife Gods Gift
items.quote: let vs not accuse God; as Adam sometime closely did; The woman, saith he, that Thou gauest mee; shee gaue me of the tree, and I ate

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Do not leave her alone; live with her in constant society, for solitude is uncomfortable and it is not good for man to be alone.
items.quote: It is not good, saith God himselfe, for Man to be alone.

items.text: Receive her help and work together with her in your labors, for you stand in need of assistance as well as society.
items.quote: he stood in need, as of Societie, so of Assistance.

items.text: Be his helper and assistant, not merely a mate, for God made you to help him.
items.quote: I will make him an Helpe, or an Assistant; not a Mate only, but an Helpe.

items.text: Be his companion, sharing his society, for without a wife man's happiness is incomplete.
items.quote: not fully happie, but halfe happie

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Be a helper to him, as God appointed: join yourself to him not for your own ease but to share his cares and support him.
items.quote: A wife is a Woman ioyned to Man to be an Helpe to him: And for a Woman to be a Wife, is to be an Help to her Husband.

items.text: Bear children and bring them up; do not shun the labor of motherhood.
items.quote: Let the younger Women, saith the Apostle, marrie, breed, (that is, beare, and bring vp) children

items.text: Govern the family: order the house and direct its affairs as a helper to your husband.
items.quote: and gouerne the familie. That is the end of their Mariage

items.text: Before marrying, seriously consider the office you take on: do not marry for ease, maintenance, sloth, vanity, or pride, but resolve to perform a wife's duties.
items.quote: that they consider seriously beforehand, what they vndertake, that they weigh well what they goe about

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Be his best companion in prosperity, sharing his joy and supporting him in all good times.
items.quote: The best Companion in Wealth

items.text: Be his ready and fit assistant in his work, helping him in all his labors and responsibilities.
items.quote: The fittest and readiest Assistant in Worke

items.text: Comfort him in his crosses and griefs, sharing his sorrows and easing his burdens.
items.quote: The greatest Comfort in Crosses and griefes

items.text: Be a willing means of issue and posterity, embracing the gift of children as God's blessing.
items.quote: The only warrantable and comfortable Meanes of Issue and posteritie

items.text: Offer yourself as God's remedy against incontinency, fulfilling the marital debt so that he may avoid sexual immorality.
items.quote: A singular and soueraigne Remedie ordained by God against Incontinencie

items.text: Be a crown of grace and honor to him, living wisely and discreetly so that he is esteemed.
items.quote: The greatest Grace and Honour, that can be, to him that hath her

items.text: Be a crown to your wife, providing her with honor and dignity.
items.quote: The Husband, saith Clemens of Alexandria, is a Crowne to his Wife.

work: A Good Wife Gods Gift: and, A Wife Indeed. Two Mariage Sermons
heading: A Wife in Deed.

items.text: Help each other draw nearer to God and walk in his ways.
items.quote: by helping either other forward in the good waies of God

items.text: Do him good and not evil all the days of your life, fulfilling the office of a wife.
items.quote: The more good shee doth her Husband, the more Comfort he receiueth from her

items.text: Seek her good in all things—temporal, spiritual, and eternal—as she does good to you.
items.quote: Giue her of the Fruit of her Hands: requite her in the same kinde againe

items.text: Mortify your own corrupt nature so that you may be a comfort to your spouse.
items.quote: This their corrupt nature therefore must married folkes seeke to quell and to kill

items.text: Take the advice and counsel of your parents and friends when seeking a spouse.
items.quote: So did Iacob herein follow his Father Isaacks aduice; contrarie to the practise of his Brother Esau

items.text: Before courting a woman under her parents' authority, seek their consent and deal with them.
items.quote: by seeking vnto those that are the Parents or Gouernours of such as they affect or desire
